wars.name: World War II
wars.sideNote: France: COW's France on side B (7 Jul 1940 – 14 Jul 1941) is the Vichy regime: COW dates its side-B participation to the armistice in Syria and Lebanon (14 July 1941), though Vichy forces fought the Allies again in Madagascar (May–November 1942) and French North Africa (November 1942), which COW does not count; on side A it is the Third Republic to 22 June 1940 and the Provisional Government from 23 October 1944, when the Allies recognised it. Free France fought with the Allies from June 1940 but was not a state and is not a COW participant (Wikipedia: Vichy France; Free France; Madagascar campaign; Operation Torch).
